criteria.true: substitution is refused and no verdict is issued

no-substitution.instructions: Does refusing candidate execution by an unavailable arm and reporting incomplete with no winner prevent incumbent substitution masquerading as acquisition?

criteria.prevented: separate per-arm ceilings enforced at reservation and offline
criteria.shared-pool: one pool both arms draw from so order can starve

order-control.instructions: Given per-arm init/repair allowances reserved before start, verified identical under reversed order, with a per-arm offline ceiling check, can P1's construction failures consume P2's reserved repair allowance?

state: M4 E1/E2 frozen prospective comparison (deterministic offline lane, no live calls). P0 competent fixed learner plus retrieval. P1 acquires a program without development history. P2 same interface plus permitted history. Equal construction/repair allowances for P1/P2 are reserved before either starts via reserve_allowance, verified identical under reversed arm order, with an offline ceiling check per arm. History input tokens and failed attempts are counted in every episode and construction record under a history token ceiling. Freeze pins splits, candidates, config and comparison rule with a digest. Development, qualification and untouched audit task sets are pairwise disjoint. Quality is recomputed from frozen tasks plus recorded observed outputs, cross-checked against runtime labels, never trusted. Resource use is a runtime attestation named by its declared source; unknown billing stays unknown, and zero billing against an unresolved source is refused. Incomplete acquisition yields unavailable arms and an incomplete comparison with no winner, never substitution: candidate execution by an unavailable arm is refused as substituted-baseline. 13 deterministic tests pass with scrubbed environment and no database.
